verdict.rationale: Sentry ships its own AI agent (Seer), so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only shows Sentry acting as an MCP server for other assistants, monitoring MCP servers, and handing Seer analysis off to coding agents. Nothing shows Sentry or Seer connecting to third-party MCP servers as a client and using their tools.
